items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: He used to come back to my house and I'll finish him up all the clarinet.

ctx.x: Now do you think it's possible to learn the clarinet just by yourself even without learning to read music? Like some people just pick it up. Sidney Bechet never did learn to read music so well I don't believe did he?

I don't think he reads much music but he plays wonderful I think. Sidney Bechet learned how to play the clarinet with a tin flute. What an tin flute. That's the way he learned. From that he pick up the clarinet. He used to come back to my house and I'll finish him up all the clarinet. Is it possible to learn to play pretty well without learning to read music very well do you think? Or do you advise people to learn music, to read the music first? Learn how to read music first. That's the first thing to do. Then…
Do you have a personal collection of things like music, sheet music and do you say photographs, records? What kind of things do you have that you own yourself now that have to do with jazz?
